{{Top}}
[[File:Mandalorian_Gloves.jpg|thumb|250px|A pair of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] gloves.]]
'''Gloves''' were articles of clothing worn over hands, which provided protection of various kinds. Numerous types of specialized gloves existed. Heavier and larger gloves were usually called [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]].

==History==
Gloves were worn by members of the [[Krozurbian]] [[Krozurbian War Council|War Council]].<ref name="SOR4">[[Droids (1995) 8|''Droids'' (1995) 8]]</ref> The [[Glove of Darth Vader]] was of particular note. The [[Jedi Consular]] [[Seenlu Kir]] wore gloves to conceal burns on her hands that she refused to have treated with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
